name: blorp
description: Blorp language support: colours, diagnostics, definitions and references from the blorp lsp server.

blorp.server.path.markdownDescription: The `blorp` binary to run as `blorp lsp`. Blank means `blorp/build/blorp` in the workspace folder when it exists, else `blorp` on `PATH`. A relative path with a directory part is taken from the workspace folder.
